content: 3:1-12 Yon munon wurimaragansi igoar eng qob suab igoai
Qen end Yon munon ya obotar wurimaragansi igoar eng Yuda wurinou seger ait end igo munon qob wurinob qamb igoai.
Qob wurinob qamb qamar: “Qenu wonou bibis biginer eng piara. End an qomon boru mogirt wab wagar,” ende qamarei.
Yon wo sarau eng ebeiner end qoan ir qob gigit qamarau munon Aisaia ete qamb gumaterei:

content.text: Munon ger seger ait end igo ete qamb atag ab igoriba: Munon Aib tap imotet musitet igama wo der eng isiba.

content: Yon wo wai kamel im end mi goan barsi qumani ne wai goan ger ba tuen barsi mi goan uiebig qumani igoai. Wo mi nub igoar eng qubusemsai qapi nob nub igoai.
Munon Yon qob qamara igub qamb yariamir eng ginam eng gagar: Yerusalem, ne Yuda ne ginam ya Yordan qani-qani igour eng.
Ende yarab wurinou qomon boru dibes qamarari ya Yordan end wurimaragansiarei.

Qen end Parisi Sadyusi nob Yon munon ya obotar wurimaragansi igoar eng igub gub qamb isumirei. Isari Yon ibag qamar: “An mani quterag gas ende. Qenu aningarambar eng your aninob qamara igub qoaub at igoumon?
An qomon boru mogirt wab wogub igo eng aninou qomon end ba dibesiarar.
Aninou uyes der ete qamb igoumon, in Abraham tumbigi end Qenu maigas me iningareminerei, qamb igoumon eng Qenu wo qeemben nomon e wurinob qamara Abraham tumbigi dari an uput qamb igorubour.
Bei ger nam qur musub me biga gab suoub qamb qo arsi igo. Nam qur musub me biginer eng tari ten wabur mutet ariramari oeiba.

Ye yat anmaragansiaum eng an oau apand buroumon eng imbigar qamb. Ego munon ger ye qanamt yariner eng qeretutnob igoriba. Ye wonou goten yau ba utin eng pi isub gab ba me utinei. Munon eng Igomurur qau ba mutet ten anmaragansieriba.
Wo sobor baub ten qib igo. Wit qur sair ten ombosairmari unab ibibima qur dara ne sair moon gusit bis wes qiumunima mut nat oab igo end guma oeiba.”
Qen end Yisas Galili wogub yar ya Yordan end isorei. Isub is Yon yat yemaragansi qamb isorei.
Isa Yon qes wara nob qamar: “Ne ye yat nemaragansierin qamb yaran ne? Ye me nemaragansierinei. Ne ye yemaragansierinen eng uber.”
Ende qamara Yisas taui nob qamar: “Ue, see ye nonob quraum gas ende eb. Ne ende ebeinen eng Qenu wonou qenunga gas ende ebeiban.” Ende qamara Yon qob toat ende ebeterei.

Yon ende ya obota wogub ne Yisas ya qurt naget igoar eng wogub ya gabut deara ne tat qitend miroau gas ende ebeterei. Aba geari Qenu wonou Igomurur qau morogan wamariau gas ende at dererei, darab wot begentarei.
Ende aba qob toau ger tat et qitend igumir eng ete at qamarei: “Wau eng yonou wau ten, sig borusi mom qenunget igoum,” ende qamarei.
